translation: A sādhaka who longs for the mood of the eternal residents of Vraja should serve, following them, both in the outer body of a practitioner and in the perfected spiritual body. (Bhakti-rasāmṛta-sindhu 1.2.295)
wbw: sevā — service; sādhaka-rūpeṇa — in the outer body of a practitioner; siddha-rūpeṇa — in the perfected spiritual body; ca — and; atra — here, on this path; hi — certainly; tat — their (of Kṛṣṇa's eternal associates); bhāva — mood; lipsunā — by one who longs to attain; kāryā — should be done; vraja-loka — the residents of Vraja; anusārataḥ — following.
sanskrit:
sevā sādhaka-rūpeṇa siddha-rūpeṇa cātra hi
tad-bhāva-lipsunā kāryā vraja-lokānusārataḥ

translation: I take shelter of the maidservants headed by Śrī Rūpa Mañjarī. By offering tāmbūla, massaging the feet, offering water, leading Her to the secret meeting and many other services, they lovingly please the Queen of Vṛndāvana; and even compared with Her friends who are dear to Her as life, they alone enter without any hesitation the places of Her pastimes. (Vraja-vilāsa-stava 38)
wbw: tāmbūla-arpaṇa — by offering tāmbūla; pāda-mardana — by massaging the feet; payaḥ-dāna — by offering water; abhisāra — by leading to the secret meeting; ādibhiḥ — and so on; vṛndāraṇya-maheśvarīm — the Queen of Vṛndāvana; priyatayā — with love; yāḥ — who; toṣayanti — please; priyāḥ — dear; prāṇa-preṣṭha-sakhī-kulāt — than the circle of friends dear as life; api — even; kila — indeed; asaṅkocitāḥ — without hesitation; bhūmikāḥ — in their service; kelī-bhūmiṣu — in the places of pastimes; rūpa-mañjarī-mukhāḥ — headed by Rūpa Mañjarī; tāḥ — of those; dāsikāḥ — maidservants; saṁśraye — I take shelter.
sanskrit:
tāmbūlārpaṇa-pāda-mardana-payo-dānābhisārādibhir
vṛndāraṇya-maheśvarīṁ priyatayā yās toṣayanti priyāḥ
prāṇa-preṣṭha-sakhī-kulād api kilāsaṅkocitā bhūmikāḥ
kelī-bhūmiṣu rūpa-mañjarī-mukhās tā dāsikāḥ saṁśraye

translation: Engaging the tongue and the mind in lovingly chanting and remembering the names, form, qualities and pastimes of Śrī Kṛṣṇa — gradually, in their sequence — living in Vraja as a follower of those who are full of spontaneous love for Him, one should spend all one's time. This is the essence of all instruction. (Śrī Upadeśāmṛta 8)
wbw: tat — His (of Śrī Kṛṣṇa); nāma-rūpa-carita-ādi — of the names, form, pastimes and so on; sukīrtana-anusmṛtyoḥ — in loving chanting and remembrance; krameṇa — gradually, in sequence; rasanā — the tongue; manasī — and the mind; niyojya — engaging; tiṣṭhan — living; vraje — in Vraja; tat — for Him; anurāgi-jana — of those full of spontaneous love; anugāmī — following; kālam — time; nayet — one should spend; akhilam — all; iti — thus; upadeśa — of instructions; sāram — the essence.
sanskrit:
tan-nāma-rūpa-caritādi-sukīrtanānu-
smṛtyoḥ krameṇa rasanā-manasī niyojya
tiṣṭhan vraje tad-anurāgi-janānugāmī
kālaṁ nayed akhilam ity upadeśa-sāram
